verdict.rationale: vLLM's CLI reference documents a command that "Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server," so starting the local server from the command line is a first-party capability. The pack never documents how to stop or shut down that server from the CLI. missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown command or behavior, hands-on or independent corroboration of the start/stop lifecycle.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
